issue.title: Make Dev Console work properly  in the face of non ASCII chars in FS paths

labels.name: area/devtools
labels.description: Issues/PR related to maven, gradle, platform and cli tooling/plugins

issue.body:
Fixes: #14504

I tested this with a file system path that had both spaces and greek characters and it worked fine

body:
I opened https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/14517.

As you can see there, it's all about handling non ASCII chars correctly in File System paths...
